text:
kyle: Heads-up — saw a weird KV cache hotspot that looks like a zippering eviction pattern on qwen-6b / mistral combos when rope scaling > 1.5x. memory climbs steadily for ~15k tokens then drops by small amounts repeatedly instead of full compaction. :eyes:
mina: ugh. reproducible locally or only on prod?
ashok: We've seen similar in longctx runs but not the repeated tiny drops. Any profiling traces?
kyle: repro on perf-box-12 with a long-run sampler. short logs: 
```
evict: slab=7 page_idx=184 free=0 -> alloc 4096
alloc: page 184 pinned_by=client-23
evict: slab=7 page_idx=185 free=2 -> alloc 4096
alloc: page 185 pinned_by=client-23
... (repeat every ~120s)
```
mina: interesting that pages are alternating adjacent indices — sounds like fragmentation + a kernel fallback thrash. Which kernel selected for the attention path?
kyle: runtime chose kernel=v3_fallback after kernel-autoselect reported high latency for the preferred kernel. we see a kernel switch around event time in traces.
jen: could be batching heuristic causing micro-bursts that change lifetime distribution, leading to prefix reuse failing and causing new pages to allocate instead of reusing old ones. Did you try forcing small fixed batch sizes?
ashok: also check KV page alignment with rope-scale. rope scaling moves positional freq and can shift which KV shards get hot. Might cause lockstep reuse on adjacent slots.
kyle: I ran two quick experiments: (1) force batch=1 -> still grows but smoother (no sharp drops). (2) disable kernel fallback -> peak mem is lower and compaction seems to do larger reclaim events.
mina: that suggests fallback kernel is not doing good KV coalescing. Can you capture the PMU samples and heap profile when fallback is active?
kyle: attached quick flame (s3://redwood/perf/kyle/4998887776/flame.svg) and heap diff (small snippet): 
```
+ slab:7.pages_in_use += 2k
+ page_resident[184] += 1
+ page_resident[185] += 1
```
ashok: perf-bot shows a spike in page faults around 4998887640-4998887720 correlating with kernel switch. perf-bot: "KV_PAGE_FAULTS +120%"
perf-bot: rolling up telemetry: models affected [qwen-6b, mistral-7b], seq>32k, rope_scale>=1.6, kernel_fallback=true.
jen: action items: 1) kyle/ashok run with kernel selector on debug and dump kernel decision stack, 2) mina to add a forced coalesce in the fallback path as a patch candidate, 3) reproduce-run with fixed batch policy to confirm batching effect.
mina: will open a PR w/ a small coalesce after fallback returns false positives. linking sha: b1c3f9a.
ashok: I'll queue the reproducer on perf-box-12 with tags: --model=qwen-6b --seq=48k --rope-scale=1.8 --batch=auto and capture /proc/pid/pagemap + perf.
kyle: repro command I used: 
```
./tools/long_kv_repro --model qwen-6b --seq 48000 --clients 8 --batch policy=auto --duration 20m --dump-heap=/tmp/heap.dump
```
jen: if we can confirm the fallback kernel doesn't coalesce its internal page list, that's a low-risk fix. Otherwise we may need to change kernel selection heuristics to prefer a kernel that does coalescing for high-rope workloads.
mina: I'll prototype coalesce in the fallback; if it reduces the zipper pattern we'll push to canary.
ashok: noted. assigning to @mina and @kyle for first pass. I'll run a binary bisect if needed.
kyle: thanks — leaving traces + logs in the thread. will append heap dumps when uplinked. :thumbsup:
